Name: Daily Quests
Author: w8AwA8w
Description:
[color=#f6b26b][size=6][b][font=Georgia][center]Daily Missions[/center][/font][/b][/size][/color][size=3][font=Georgia]This mod adds a system for short daily missions. In total there are 42 unique missions, 70+ missions including the different monsters/items that can be selected for a mission. Missions are made to be short and sweet; any single mission can be done generally in at most half an in-game day.

Every day your mission board will have 3 missions. Completing a mission replaces it with a new one, and every four completed mission will reward you with money and loot (Prize Ticket, Skill Book, Tea). The mission board can be accessed through the journal or by hotkey (By default backspace.

Each day you can also reroll up to three missions if you don't like them. Completing 4 missions gives another reroll.
[/font]﻿

[/size][color=#f6b26b][size=6][b][font=Georgia][center]Translations[/center][/font][/b][/size][/color][size=3][font=Georgia]This mod includes a translatable i18n file. If you'd like to make a translation you can make a separate mod page with the translation file or send me the translated i18n file. I'll give credit here for all translations done.[/font][/size]

[color=#f6b26b][size=6][b] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ [font=Georgia] ﻿Config
[/font][/b][/size][/color]
[font=Georgia][size=3]This mod has one config option to allow you to change the key bind for opening the daily missions menu.

1.0.2 now has two new config options for max rerolls and the number of quests completable per day. The display will still max at showing 3 rerolls[/size][/font]



[color=#f6b26b][size=6][font=Courier New] ﻿[/font] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿     [b][font=Georgia]Compatibility[/font]
[/b][/size][/color]
[font=Georgia][size=3]All mods that I've tested have had no compatibility issues with this mod. If there are any compatibility issues let me know! 

This mod can be added into a save at any point, no issues there!

There are a few mod-specific missions for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature In The Valley[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28914]Boss Battles[/url].﻿

If you'd like to add some specific / unique missions for your mod, let me know!



Note: This mod was made as part of a 3-day modding challenge. This is here just to say if you have a mod idea, go for it!
[/size][/font]
